verdicts.reason: A drops the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow, sets the body copy almost as large as the headline, and shrinks the 'Reserve a Case' CTA into a tiny pill in the right column. That CTA ends up the same size as the illegible legal block, which wrecks the hierarchy and leaves the two columns lopsided. B keeps the original's centred reading order (eyebrow, headline, body, prominent CTA, ship note, legal) with the brand intact, but it is cramped: the headline packs tightly under the eyebrow, there is little breathing room between blocks, and the legal text is oversized compared with the 'Ships late June' line.
